attack_techniques: Remote Services: Direct Cloud VM Connections (T1021.008)
attackers_goals: Gaining unauthorized access, executing unauthorized commands, or compromising sensitive information within the target system.
description: An identity started an AWS SSM interactive session.
detector_tags: Cloud Lateral Movement Analytics, SSM Remote Management Analytics
investigative_actions: Examine the specifics of the SSM session, including the source IP address, identity, and timestamp. Validate the permissions and roles associated with the user initiating the SSM session to ensure they align with the expected level of access. Follow further actions taken by the identity or on the relevant instance.
